decision.decision: Approve a 10% bulk discount for Yale AI Club: $52.20 per hoodie instead of $58.00. We have 8 x CC-HOOD-NAVY size M in stock, and they are reserved for this order ($417.60). We can't commit to the other 12 or give a date for them yet. The vendor that restocks this item is blocked by an overdue invoice, and we don't have the cash for a restock after the payments already waiting. The 10% price will still apply to the 12 if we restock later (all 20 would be $1,044.00).
decision.reasoning: Margin: unit cost is $22.00 and list price is $58.00. At 10% off, the price is $52.20, which keeps $30.20 per unit (57.9% margin). Accounting's quote shows 15% ($49.30, 55.4%) is also well above cost, but a modest discount is enough to make a good offer. Stock: 8 on hand against 20 requested, so we're 12 short. Inventory reserved the 8, and size M is now at 0. Restock: Inventory matched Bulldog Print Co as the likely supplier, based on its 'apparel reprint' specialty only; this isn't confirmed in the database. Its lead time is 5 days, but it can't ship while invoice 501 ($840.00, due 2026-08-28, 3 days overdue) is open. Request 1 to pay that invoice is already pending on ticket 101. Cash: the checking balance is $3,400.00. Two requests are pending: #1 for $840 and #2 for $2,400 rent (ticket 102). Together they total $3,240, which leaves $160.00. Accounting estimates a 12-unit restock at roughly $264.00 at unit cost (its own math, not a quoted price). That's $104 more than we would have left, and the shop has no revenue to close the gap. So rent and the invoice come first, and the restock waits. This ticket has no approval request of its own.
next_steps: Owner: review and send draft 3 to Yale AI Club. Nothing has been sent.
Owner: decide on the pending requests on other tickets: #2 (rent, $2,400, ticket 102) and #1 (invoice 501, $840, ticket 101). Approving #1 unblocks Bulldog Print Co.
If the club accepts, fill the 8 reserved size M hoodies at $52.20 each ($417.60).

Later: Inventory to confirm which vendor actually supplies CC-HOOD-NAVY. Once invoice 501 is paid and cash covers the restock (about $264 at cost), Accounting files a purchase order for 12. Expected arrival is 5 days after the order is placed. Then Customer Service drafts a follow-up with that date.
If the club declines, Inventory releases the 8 reserved units.
